equations.system_net_force: F_net(phi)=-2 kappa_F m omega_B [u_phi^T Q V_E] u(phi)
equations.instantaneous_parallel_scalar: F_parallel_scalar=F_net dot c_hat=-2 kappa_F m omega_B [u_phi^T Q V_E] sin(2phi)
equations.instantaneous_perpendicular_vector: F_perp=F_net-F_parallel=-2 kappa_F m omega_B [u_phi^T Q V_E] cos(2phi)e(phi)
equations.perpendicular_condition: (F_net dot c_hat)=0 iff [u_phi^T Q V_E] sin(2phi)=0
equations.closed_cycle_impulse: J_B=integral_0^T F_net dt=pi kappa_F m c_hat cross (Q V_E)
equations.orthogonality: c_hat dot J_B=0 and c_hat dot <F_net>=0
